description: Source code implementing proxy configuration logic for network proxy resolution, including classes and functions for managing proxy rules, parsing proxy strings, and applying proxy settings based on URLs.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Represents network proxy configuration, including automatic and manual proxy rules.

classes.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules
classes.description: Encapsulates rules for proxy selection, including different proxy lists and schemes.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::Apply
methods.description: Applies proxy rules to a given URL, determining the appropriate proxy settings.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::ParseFromString
methods.description: Parses proxy rules from a string representation.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two proxy configurations.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::HasAutomaticSettings
methods.description: Determines if automatic proxy settings are enabled.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ToValue
methods.description: Serializes proxy configuration to a value object.
